wright2006_provenance.column_interpretation: strike_deg | dip_deg | rake_deg | east_km | north_km | length_km | top_km | bottom_km | n_along | n_downdip | group | type
wright2006_provenance.column_note: top_km/bottom_km apply to fault and dike rows; for point rows column 7 is the source depth and column 8 is unused (recorded as depth_km/column8_unused)

extension_se.reason: the 2026 dike is aligned with the southernmost segment (~4 deg strike difference, endpoints 0.35 and 0.88 km off its line) and overruns its SE end; the extension lets the data bound the opening instead of the plane edge

wright2006_provenance.fault_treatment: east graben fault grafted unchanged from the primary trace-supported fit (results/distributed_fit_mapped.json, geometry a808d60e8b10); its along-strike axis metadata refers to the uniform-fit frame preserved in wright2006_provenance.fault_frame, not the s axis above
wright2006_provenance.frame_note: strike/trace_centre describe the chord of the segmented trace (origin at s=0, azimuth toward increasing s); position reconstruction from them is approximate — use the patch arrays
wright2006_provenance.received: email from Juliet Biggs, 2026-08-26, subject 'dyke geometry' (geometry of Wright et al. 2006 and the Hamling et al. papers)
wright2006_provenance.s_axis: s=0 at the NW end of the original plane, increasing SE; the SE extension occupies s > original length
wright2006_provenance.units: UTM 37N kilometres, converted to metres here

reference_operator: observations and Green functions both pass through the block-space far-field plane projection (basis: constant, east, north; fit region beyond the far-field radius); model_farfield_plane_m is the fitted model's removed plane per dataset

lambda_selection.rule: smoothing weight reused from the primary fit (distributed_fit.json) so variants stay comparable

potency_partition.note: sum(fault area x slip) / sum(dike area x opening); not a moment-tensor ratio

notes: geometry fixed a priori; only dislocation magnitudes inverted
datasets normalized to co-event-through-18-July with the S1 decay summary
weights: per-dataset far-field robust sigma; offsets: per-dataset nuisance
regularization: Laplacian per surface, single lambda selected by minimum mean 10-km checkerboard held-out RMS for the primary fit
complete geometry loaded directly from the recorded source file; no source-code geometry constants were used
